verdict.rationale: AMD's vendor claims about 3D V-Cache (up to 208MB) and boost/overclocking flexibility are corroborated by independent hands-on reviews from TechPowerUp and Tom's Hardware showing best-in-class gaming FPS (37% faster than Intel's flagship, near-parity with 9800X3D, fastest 16-core gaming chip). Missing for 10: no discussion of integrated GPU class since this is a desktop CPU without iGPU gaming benchmarks, and no frame-time/1% low breakdown across a wide game suite.
